cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 with prominent buffers Cocamidopropyl Betaine @4 and Coco-Glucoside @10, no reinforcing strong anionic. Laureth-4 @14 is a low-ethoxylate thickener (not a route).

conditioningLevel.rationale: High by C2: prominent payload lipid Hydrogenated Castor Oil @9 in place of a silicone, prominent cationic Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @6, pearlizing route Glycol Distearate @12, humectant route Panthenol @7; plus weak refatters Glyceryl Oleate @11, PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate @15. Counter-signal: the only lipid is a hydrogenated castor oil that often serves as opacifier/structurant at low dose, no silicone; moderate is the neighbor.

weightPotential.counterevidence: W-RICH holds (material waxy Hydrogenated Castor Oil @9 converging with prominent cationic guar @6); three deposition families; waxy lipids are more persistent.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: A prominent cationic guar, a waxy hydrogenated lipid and weak refatters plausibly leave noticeable but bounded residue.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: the rich route needs limited reset, but resetCapacity is moderate (C1 SLES with two buffers); only one lipid, which in shampoos is often a low-dose structurant, and a single light guar. Not low: material lipid + cationic polymer + refatters (W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: W-RICH with moderate reset; dose of the hydrogenated castor oil unknown; high is the realistic neighbor.
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: W-RICH (HCO @9 + guar @6) plus weak refatters, offset by moderate C1 reset; neighbor high.
